content.short: Aurelius Finance integrates CDPs and lending markets on Mantle, offering users flexible borrowing against collateral through two complementary mechanisms.
content.description: Aurelius Finance is an innovative DeFi protocol on Mantle that combines Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) mechanisms with traditional lending markets in a single platform. Users can either mint the protocol's native stablecoin against their collateral via the CDP mechanism or borrow existing assets through the lending market, giving maximum flexibility in how they access liquidity. This dual-mechanism approach makes Aurelius one of the most versatile borrowing platforms in the Mantle ecosystem.
content.meta: Aurelius Finance integrates CDPs and lending markets for comprehensive borrowing solutions on Mantle. Discover Aurelius Finance on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
